chars.Y: YOUNES: a young man wearing a bright mustard-yellow hoodie with a white chest stripe, black jogger trousers and white sneakers.
chars.F: FRIEND: a young man wearing a dark green bomber jacket, light blue jeans and red sneakers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES walks proudly through the courtyard of a Moroccan university faculty with arches and palm trees, holding English literature books under his arm, carefree.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan university hallway, FRIEND points at a registration board while YOUNES shrugs and follows him, deciding to enroll just because his friend does.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan café, YOUNES talks passionately with big hand gestures while FRIEND sits across the table sipping mint tea, looking bored.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES sits on his bed in a small Moroccan bedroom, laptop open showing colorful rising charts, confident smug expression, pointing at the screen.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES counts a few small banknotes from his student scholarship at a modest desk in a Moroccan apartment, worried look, empty wallet beside him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES leans close to his phone screen in a dim room at night, eyes wide with excitement, glowing light on his face, delivery boxes stacked in the corner.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES lies on a sofa in a Moroccan living room scrolling his phone for hours, empty tea glasses and snack wrappers around him, clock on the wall showing late night.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES excitedly draws a big plan with arrows on a whiteboard in his room while FRIEND stands beside him, skeptical, arms crossed.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES stands frozen in the middle of his room staring at his phone, shocked worried face, dramatic shadows, papers falling to the floor.
